category_edits.rationale: Scale history input embeddings by a fixed, bounded training-frequency feature so gated attention can distinguish common items from rare ones. Counts use only each category's training interactions. Persist the feature as a checkpoint buffer; the generated predictor imports the same model class and restores it automatically. Candidate embeddings, learned parameters, HSTU topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

edits.find:
self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(maxlen + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
edits.replace:
self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        self.register_buffer("input_frequency_scale", torch.ones(itemnum + 1))
        self.input_frequency_scale[0] = 0.0
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(maxlen + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)

training_counts = np.zeros(itemnum + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    for history in user_train.values():
        np.add.at(training_counts, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1)
    training_counts[0] = 0
    log_counts = np.log1p(training_counts.astype(np.float64))
    frequency_scale = 0.75 + 0.5 * log_counts / max(float(log_counts.max()), 1.0)
    frequency_scale[0] = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.input_frequency_scale.copy_(torch.as_tensor(
            frequency_scale, dtype=model.input_frequency_scale.dtype, device=device
        ))
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
